minutes_text:
SENIOR ADVISORY COMMITTEE
  Minutes of Regular Meeting

  Wednesday, November 20, 2019
_________________________________________________________________
1. A regular meeting of the La Verne Senior Advisory Committee was called to order at
  10:00 AM on Wednesday, November 20, 2019.
  Members present: Terry Kistler, Chick Campo, Lorraine Missick, George Borst, and
  Bette Donovan.
  Members absent: Scott Snider
  Staff Present: Bill Aguirre, Staff Liaison, Yvonne Duran, Recreation Coordinator,
  and Brandon Granillo, Recreation Coordinator
  It was moved and seconded to approve the minutes of the Wednesday, October 16,
  2019 meeting. Motion carried
  Unfinished Business

2. Guest Speaker: Dan Keesey, Assistant City Manager. Informed us about the
  proposed City Sales Tax Measure. It will protect the quality of life in La Verne.
  Provide: A Full Service Community, no contract services, stay competitive, 28,000
  first response calls per year, pay raises for employees and enhance other services
  for the City. Keep the money local
  .
3. Nutrition Program: The average meals served for October was 36.

4. Bingo Report: October: Beginning balance was $2,468.37; ending balance was
  $2,501.63; change was $33.26. Average number of 50 players this session.
  Expenses paid: $189, Bingo Bugle, $232.74 Bingo West, $5 bank fee. Total: 426.74.
  New people have not been attending.

5. Meals on Wheels: Delivered 24 meals to recipients in September for a total of 463
  meals. Delivered to 46 participants in October for a total of 825 meals.

6. Account Balance: To date, account balance is $3,866.07.

7. Fee Schedule for Use of the Facilities: Garden Friends have not paid. Bingo will pay
  in January

New Business
 8. Upcoming Events:
  Thursday, November 28th & Friday, November 29th – Center closed in observance of
  Thanksgiving.
  Monday, December 2nd – Tree Lighting Ceremony at City Hall, 6:30 PM
  Thursday, December 5th – Senior Holiday Luncheon, (Santa & Chamber Singers)
  11:30 AM
  Saturday, December 14th – Winter Wonderland at Heritage Park, 9:00 AM – 1:00 PM
  Tuesday, December 24th – Center closed at 12:30 PM in observance of
  Christmas Eve.
  Wednesday, December 25th – Center closed in observance of Christmas.
  Wednesday, January 1st – Center closed in observance of New Year’s Day.
  Thursday, January 2nd – City Sponsored Lunch (New Year’s Theme), 11:30 AM

9. Facilities Report: Roof repair in Craft Room located at the Community Center,
  postponed due to the weather. The plumbing lines will be cleaned every 3 years at
  the Community Center. Veterans Hall is up to date.

10. Public Comments: Brandon asked for sign-ups for the Holiday Luncheon. Line
  Dancing is doing well. Health Fair was a success. Discussed the possibility of doing
  two health fairs, possibly having one in the summer.

  Yvonne announced that the Christmas Tree candy packaging will be held at the
  Community Center, not at the Fire Department this year. Santa will not be driving
  through the Mobile Home Parks anymore.

  George mentioned that the Awards for Golf was held on November 2 nd. Twenty-five
  people were in attendance. Everyone enjoyed the event. George Borst was the
  winner of the tier two championship.

  Lorraine is currently working on recruiting others for Senior Advisory Committee.

11. Adjourn: A motion was made to adjourn the meeting, motion approved and carried.
  Meeting was adjourned at 11:00 AM. (December meeting is dark).The next meeting
  will be held on Wednesday, January 15th at 10:00 AM.
